parameters.name: AccessGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the permission group that is attached to the mount target.

parameters.name: DualStackMountTargetDomain
parameters.description:
The dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) domain name of the mount target.

>  Only Extreme NAS file systems that reside in the Chinese mainland support IPv6.

parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description:
The ID of the file system.

*   Sample ID of a General-purpose NAS file system: `31a8e4****`.
*   The IDs of Extreme NAS file systems must start with `extreme-`, for example, `extreme-0015****`.

parameters.name: MountTargetDomain
parameters.description: The IPv4 domain name of the mount target.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the mount target.

Valid values:

*   Active: The mount target is available.
*   Inactive: The mount target is unavailable.

>  Only General-purpose File Storage NAS (NAS) file systems support changing the mount target status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas modify-mount-target --file-system-id 1ca4040000 --mount-target-domain 1ca404a666-w0000.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com --access-group-name classic-test --status Inactive --dual-stack-mount-target-domain 174494b666-x0000.dualstack.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com --access-point-access-only true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas ModifyMountTarget --region cn-hangzhou --Status Inactive --DualStackMountTargetDomain '174494b666-x0000.dualstack.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com' --MountTargetDomain '1ca404a666-w0000.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com' --AccessGroupName 'classic-test' --FileSystemId 1ca4040000 --AccessPointAccessOnly true
